rows.en:
Hahaha… Have you forgotten, Black Sun?

Battle Hopper is a machine built for the next Creation King! Of course I can control it!
Listen to me, Battle Hopper!
Listen to me, Battle Hopper!
It's useless!
Here I come! Get run down by your own machine and go to the next world!
Stop, Battle Hopper! Stop it!
Stop, Battle Hopper! Stop it!
Battle Hopper is mine now! Go to hell, Black Sun!
Making Nobuhiko go this far… I hate it… I hate the Creation King!
Making Nobuhiko go this far… I hate it… I hate the Creation King!
Battle Hopper! Have you lost your mind!?
Battle Hopper! Have you lost your mind!?

…!? Battle Hopper is crying…

I see! They took your body, but not your heart… Don't cry, Battle Hopper! I'll save you right now!

…!? Battle Hopper is crying…

I see! They took your body, but not your heart… Don't cry, Battle Hopper! I'll save you right now!
King Stone Flash!
Battle Hoppeeer!
Battle Hopper! Hang in there!
RI… RIDER…
What are you trying to say? Battle Hoppeeer!?
TH… THANK YOU… RI… RIDER…
No, Battle Hoppeeer! Don't die, don't you dare die!
Watch me, Battle Hopper! I'll avenge you, I swear it!
It's… not over yet… Not yet!
Nobuhiko…
Black Sun… the final fight… This time… I'll send you to hell… Ughh…
Nobuhiko, the fight is already over. Please, get your human heart back!

Silence! I hate you… I'll defeat you, I swear…

Gh… Ugh, uuugh…
Stop! You can't use the Shadow Kick in that condition! You'll destroy yourself!
Shadow Kiiick! Tohhh…
Uwah… Uuugh…
Nobuhiko, hang in there!

Black Sun…

That Satan Saber… Without it… I'd be too scared to go to hell! Please…
Mmph…

It's no use… I have no strength left… Black Sun… I'm going to die. But don't think you've won!

You'll suffer for the rest of your life. Because you killed your best friend… this Nobuhiko! You'll live the rest of your life in regret… Heh heh heh… Hahahahaha!

I am the next Creation Kiiing!

Ahh… the sunspot is vanishing… my life is ending…

Splendid, Black Sun! You have been chosen as the next Creation King! Hurry! Take the King Stone from Shadow Moon's body!
Uugh… Creation King…
Don't mess with me! Because of you, so many people have…

The sunspot… the sunspot is vanishing…

Black Sun! It's not too late even now… Take the King Stone from Shadow Moon!
Shut up!

This hole leads all the way to the center of the Earth…

If you absolutely refuse… I'll leap into this hole and blow the Earth to smithereens with my last strength! Is that what you want?
What!? I won't let you! Toh!
Ngh… A barrier!?

There's little time left before the sunspot vanishes…

Will you let the Earth be destroyed? Or… will you obediently take the throne of the Creation King?
There's no time… Do you still refuse? Black Sun, I'm jumping in!
Stooop!
Heh heh heh…

What do I do? What do I do?

That's it! If I'm a candidate for the next Creation King too… Satan Saber!
Black Sun… Kotaro… Minami…
This is the end! Creation Kiiing!
Gugaaaaah!?

Curse you… Black Sun!

I will return, without fail! As long as there is evil in the human heart, I will surely return… Never forget thaaat!
…!? Nobuhikooo!

…………

Farewell… Kotaro…
Goodbye, Nobuhiko…
At last Gorgom was destroyed, and the rain that began to fall from that moment kept falling for five days, then ten, as if to wash away all evil. And peace returned to the Earth.
But Kotaro was alone… There was no one left he could call family. Memories of happy days and painful days came back to Kotaro's mind!
Carrying all those memories in his heart, Kotaro goes on… Kotaro won't be beaten! As long as there is evil on this Earth, he will keep fighting.
Hang in there, Kotaro Minami! As long as you're here, we'll keep fighting too! Fight on, Kamen Rider BLACK!
Uwaaaah…
Uwaaaah…
Damn… Oyassan…
Whoa… Damn it…!
Defeat Destron Executive Doktor G!
Defeat Executive Doktor G and all Destron Combatants, and rescue Tobei Tachibana!
Defeat Executive Doktor G, all Destron Combatants and the Gigants!
Defeat the Shocker and Gel-Shocker forces, the four great executives, Crab Laser, all Destron Combatants and the Gigants!
Defeat Shadow Moon!
Kotaro Minami, Takeshi Hongo or Hayato Ichimonji is defeated
<c3>All Riders</c>' Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
"Uninhabited Island South of the Ogasawara Islands Blows Up! Cause Unknown!" it says…
What is it? What's going on?
Honestly, you kids…
"At least read the newspaper properly!" Right?
Hm? Well, yeah…
Huh? What's that about!?
"At least read the newspaper properly!" Isn't that right?
Is Japan finally going to sink?
What a thing to say, Jiro!
Oyassan… This article over here bothers me too.

uncertain: U11878/U11880: Battle Hopper's katakana speech rendered in capitals (like One-Seven).
U11893: Shadow Moon asks for the Satan Saber; U11894 he uses it (on himself, as in the show); not stated in the text.
U11908: 竢補 read as 候補 "candidate".
U11916-U11919: one narration over four rows; 姶め/鏡いた/膤/鏡ける read as 始め/続いた/胸/続ける.
U11924/U11926: 備幹割 read as 大幹部 "Executive"; 魔込員 as 戦闘員, 中て as 全て.
U11927: 四大幹部 rendered "the four great executives"; Crab Laser listed separately as in the Japanese.
U11930: system message formatted like B0001.
U11934/U11937: [HERO2] anticipates Tobei's nagging; rendered as a quoted line.
